name: C++: local includes become one source file
explanation: The local include selects dsu. Its head block becomes .Header, its code block becomes a library body, and the solution’s code block becomes .Code. The local include stays outside the generated source.

name: Rust: a local module becomes an inline module
library: pub fn twice(x: i32) -> i32 { x * 2 }
explanation: The local module declaration and use statement stay outside @code. The use statement selects the math snippet; the modifier puts its contents inside an inline mod math in the prepared source.

name: LLVM IR: a comment becomes a dependency declaration
library:
; @head begin
declare i32 @puts(ptr)
; @head end
; @code begin
@message = private constant [3 x i8] c"OK\00"
; @code end
source:
; @include fast_io
; @code begin
define i32 @main() {
  %result = call i32 @puts(ptr @message)
  ret i32 0
}
; @code end
explanation: The comment matches lib.regex, while declarations and executable IR travel through separate head/code blocks. Eitri does not need to understand LLVM syntax.
